title: Broad federated subject
summary: The role trusts GitHub tokens with a wildcard subject. Any workflow, on any branch, in any repo of the organisation can assume the production role. That includes a feature branch anyone with push access can create.
notes: Worst case: no sub condition at all. The role then trusts every GitHub Actions job in the world that requests the sts.amazonaws.com audience.
Fix: StringEquals on sub, pinned to one repo and a protected environment (repo:contoso/app:environment:prod). Then add required reviewers on the GitHub environment.
Azure federated credentials match subjects exactly, so wildcards need an explicit opt-in there. The equivalent mistake on Azure is a pull_request or branch subject on a production identity.
